keyEvents.text: Delay in match (Real Betis).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Elche. Grady Diangana replaces Ali Houary because of an injury.
Second Half begins Elche 0, Real Betis 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Fer Niño (Elche).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Federico Redondo (Elche) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Grady Diangana (Elche) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Real Betis. Dani Ceballos replaces Pablo Fornals.
Substitution, Real Betis. Aitor Ruibal replaces Antony.
Substitution, Elche. Tete Morente replaces Germán Valera.
Substitution, Elche. Abiel Osorio replaces Fer Niño.
Substitution, Elche. Facundo Buonanotte replaces Lucas Cepeda.
Substitution, Elche. Pedro Bigas replaces Roy Revivo.
Substitution, Real Betis. Rodrigo Riquelme replaces Abde Ezzalzouli.
Substitution, Real Betis. José Antonio Morante replaces Troy Parrott.
Goal! Elche 0, Real Betis 1. Rodrigo Riquelme (Real Betis) right footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal.
Martim Neto (Elche) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Real Betis. Nelson Deossa replaces Isco.
Javi Morcillo (Elche) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Elche 0, Real Betis 2. Marc Bartra (Real Betis) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Dani Ceballos with a cross following a corner.
